useradd --system --home-dir /var/lib/thetis --shell /usr/sbin/nologin thetis
install -d -m 0755 /var/lib
fallocate -l 4294967296 /var/lib/thetis.img
chmod 0600 /var/lib/thetis.img
mkfs.ext4 -q -m 0 -L thetis-state /var/lib/thetis.img
install -d -m 0700 /var/lib/thetis
write /etc/systemd/system/var-lib-thetis.mount
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now var-lib-thetis.mount
install -d -m 0755 /opt/thetis /opt/thetis/releases /opt/thetis/etc
install verified release and retained seed sources
install -d -m 0755 /opt/thetis/node
install verified Node archive
write recipe.json, seed.json and thetis launcher
write accounts.json (1 account)
install -d -o root -g root -m 0700 /etc/thetis
head -c 32 /dev/urandom > /etc/thetis/master.key
chmod 0400 /etc/thetis/master.key
Back up /etc/thetis/master.key; without it the sealed secrets are unrecoverable.
seal provider API key in the kernel secret store
install -d -m 0755 /etc/systemd/system
write /etc/systemd/system/thetis.service
write /etc/systemd/system/thetis-update.service
write /etc/systemd/system/thetis-update.timer
systemctl daemon-reload
chown -R thetis:thetis /var/lib/thetis
chown root:thetis /opt/thetis/releases
chmod 1775 /opt/thetis/releases
write install.json
systemctl enable --now thetis.service
systemctl enable --now thetis-update.timer
